question.prompt: If \(p\) is a necessary and sufficient condition for \(q\), record “\(p\) implies \(q\)” as 1 and “\(q\) implies \(p\)” also as 1. When both hold, what is the sum of the two numbers?

solutions.explanation: Necessary and sufficient means that the implication holds in both directions, so \(1+1=2\).
solutions.title: Add the two recorded values
